# controllers that draw nothing themselves (settled, no asset of their own): EFFECT_HANDGUN_MUZZLE_FLASH 0x02B effectControlTask2B (transient point light + MUZZLE_FLARE + casing 0x036 or 0x066 + MUZZLE_SPARK; P229 profile: no flare, no light); EFFECT_ACTOR_MUZZLE_FLASH 0x06A effectControlTask6A (light + MUZZLE_FLARE at 1536+jitter, then three MUZZLE_SPARK; no casing); EFFECT_RIFLE_MUZZLE_FLASH 0x06B effectControlTask6B (light + MUZZLE_FLARE + MUZZLE_FLARE_ADDITIVE + case model 0x067); EFFECT_SHOTGUN_MUZZLE_FLASH 0x0A1 effectControlTaskA1 (reddish light + MUZZLE_FLARE; buckshot: 12 PIXEL_SPARK + 12 SHOTGUN_SPARK_LINE; other ammunition: MUZZLE_FLARE_ADDITIVE, slug also _effectDrawMuzzleFlash; MUZZLE_SPARK + 4 MUZZLE_SPARK_THROWN + shell 0x068); EFFECT_GRENADE_MUZZLE_FLASH 0x06C effectControlTask6C (light + _effectDrawMuzzleFlash + 4x(MUZZLE_SPARK_THROWN + MUZZLE_SPARK), later 3 MUZZLE_SPARK + shell 0x091); EFFECT_RELOAD_EMITTER 0x06E effectControlTask6E (3 MUZZLE_SPARK + one 0x091 per tick for 12 ticks or the argument's high half; player_actor.c:8775 MM1 reload); EFFECT_RELOAD_CASINGS_DROP 0x06D effectControlTask6D (six 0x036 with profile 9; player_actor.c:8737 Mongoose reload); EFFECT_IMPACT_SPARK 0x03B effectControlTask3B (flash sprite above + 6 PIXEL_SPARK); EFFECT_GRENADE_EXPLOSION 0x071 effectControlTask71 (round 10 fragmentation: EXPLOSION + 2 BOUNCING_SPARK, then subtractive and additive SMOKE_PUFF; round 11 airburst: IMPACT_FLASH, SMOKE_PUFF pairs, untextured glow band, 3 SPARK_STREAK per tick for 3 ticks; round 12 riot: IMPACT_FLASH, SMOKE_PUFF pairs, blue glow band + additive screen tint; each with transient point light slot 1).
